title: Java Beer Summit
tagline: The biggest summer Java event in Sofia
thankYou: // thanks for coming — see you next summer! 🍻

location.name: Toplocentrala
location.description: A cultural hub in a former heat plant near South Park — indoor galleries, outdoor terraces, and the Bar Stage for exactly this kind of summer evening.
location.directions: Near South Park and the Hilton. Trams 1, 6, 7 (Blvd. P. Slaveykov); buses 72, 76, 102, 204, 304, 604 (Blvd. Cherni Vrah); metro M2 (European Union).

about.intro: Thank you to everyone who joined us at [Toplocentrala](https://toplocentrala.bg) on 26 August — short talks, cold beers, and a packed evening with the Java community. Java Beer Summit is an annual event co-organized by the [Bulgarian Java User Group](https://jug.bg) and [Codexio](https://codexio.bg). It brings people together in an informal setting, strengthens bonds within the community, and welcomes newcomers into it.

highlights.title: Thanks for coming
highlights.text: To everyone who checked in, poured a beer, joined the panel, or grabbed the open mic — you made the night.

highlights.title: Panel & open mic
highlights.text: A discussion panel on AI in everyday life, then the stage open for whoever had something to say.

highlights.title: Networking first
highlights.text: Plenty of room to catch up, meet new people, and keep the conversation going until midnight.
